facts.statement: A community Halloween Dance Party was scheduled on Wednesday, October 21, running 4pm to 6pm PDT (11pm to 1am UTC) on Server 1.
Players were invited to wear costumes; the event was described as the biggest dance party yet.
facts.quote: Wear your best costume and get ready to shake your bones across the cemetery floor.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Community Event: Halloween Dance Party)
article_summaries.summary: A SOE community event announcement for a Halloween Dance Party held on Server 1 in Blackspore, with players teleporting to Bone Bog Cemetery. The page was captured 2009-10-27 and says the post was made about 1 week and 3 days earlier, so the posting date is only approximate (around 2009-10-17); the event itself was scheduled for Wednesday October 21 (2009).
